name: Modern Healthcare Technology Holdings Limited
summary: Modern Healthcare Technology Holdings Limited, formerly Modern Beauty Salon Holdings Limited, is an investment holding company serving customers in Hong Kong, mainland China, Singapore and Australia. It earns revenue from beauty and wellness services, including facials, aesthetics, slimming, spa and massage, and from skincare and wellness products sold under many brands such as FERRECARE and Byotea. Smaller activities include sub-franchising, training, property holding, hospitality and fund management.
